The '''System IV''' was a model of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] developed by [[Loronar Defense Industries]].

==History==
[[Loronar Defense Industries]]' System IV was the company's most advanced model of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]]. The introduction of the weapon into the market, alongside the [[MAS-2xB]] mobile turbolaser, helped to cement Loronar's position as one of the dominant weapon manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGWT" />
